title: Why Ram Killed the TRX (And What Came Next)
description:
In August twenty twenty-three, Ram told the world that the TRX chapter was coming to a close. Two years and four months later, Ram unveiled a faster one. Between those two announcements, the truck was retired, replaced, shelved, and revived. This is the story of why Ram killed the TRX, what it said, what it did not say, and what came next. We read Wikipedia, KBB, Edmunds, Motor1, SlashGear, Hagerty, the Auto Wire, the Autoblog interview with Ram's chief executive, and Ram's own release. The key question, why it was killed, has no single official answer in what we found. So we show who said what, and we mark every interpretation as an interpretation.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
